# SSA 2027 COLA facts (fetched 2026-10-14 via browser; ssa.gov blocks curl)
Sources: https://www.ssa.gov/news/en/press/releases/2026-10-14.html ; https://www.ssa.gov/news/en/cola/factsheets/2027.html
- COLA 3.6% for 2027, based on CPI-W Q3 2025 -> Q3 2026. Announced Wed Oct 14, 2026.
- ~72M Social Security beneficiaries: increase begins January 2027. ~7.3M SSI: increased payments begin Dec 31, 2026. 76M total (some get both).
- Average retirement benefit +$75/mo. All retired workers avg $2,095 -> $2,170 (Jan 2027 est).
- Aged couple both receiving $3,238 -> $3,355; widowed mother + 2 children $3,932 -> $4,074; aged widow(er) alone $1,936 -> $2,005; disabled worker+spouse+child(ren) $2,970 -> $3,077; all disabled workers $1,642 -> $1,701.
- Tax rate 7.65% employee / 15.30% self-employed unchanged (OASDI 6.2% to taxable max; HI 1.45% all earnings; +0.9% above $200k/$250k MFJ).
- Max taxable earnings $184,500 (2026) -> $192,300 (2027). Medicare HI no limit.
- Quarter of coverage $1,890 -> $1,970.
- Earnings test under FRA $24,480/yr ($2,040/mo) -> $25,560/yr ($2,130/mo); $1 withheld per $2 above.
- Year reaching FRA $65,160/yr ($5,430/mo) -> $67,920/yr ($5,660/mo); $1 per $3; months before FRA only. None from month FRA reached.
- SGA non-blind $1,690 -> $1,770/mo; blind $2,830 -> $2,950/mo. Trial work period $1,210 -> $1,270/mo.
- Max benefit worker retiring at FRA $4,152 -> $4,188/mo.
- SSI federal payment standard individual $994 -> $1,029/mo; couple $1,491 -> $1,544/mo. Resource limits $2,000/$3,000 unchanged. Student exclusion $2,410->$2,500/mo, $9,730->$10,080/yr.
- COLA notice: my Social Security online starting late November (enroll paperless by Nov 18); paper by mail in December. Simplified one-page notice.
- Medicare 2027 premium: not in release; available at medicare.gov, in my SS Message Center late November.
- Prior: 2.8% for 2026; 8.7% for 2023 (per CNBC).
